notes: All 8 Stage II boards now hold the real drawings at true scale: tight 1:200 plans (4 typical floors fit board 4 with a narrow legend; ground floor with surroundings + −1 + −2 on board 3; tower floors + roof on board 5), sections, elevations, 1:50 façade section, schemes.

Organiser tables generated from live data (F.15.A/B/C, F.14.B in xlsx + PDF, metadata stripped). Cross-checks found: usable area from rooms 8,850 m² (not 8,400) → parking minimum rises to ≈ 107; 5 programme items without a room; core areas double-counted on the mezzanine; garden paths over 101 m² of preserved allotments; '.OCZ' room numbers.

These and the plans agent's structural findings (column lines in corridors, wing tract, storeys 5–6 capacity, garage ≤ 92 spaces) are queued for the v1.1 re-run (docs/90_audyt/do_przeliczenia_po_v11.md).
